houses.name: The Grey Rhino
houses.line: Slow feet, sealed letters. Nobody reads what we write.

houses.name: General of KITE
houses.line: Steady as the river, we hold the fords—let none cross while we stand firm!

houses.name: Orchid's Iron Guard
houses.line: Hold the river line. Patience is our blade. We break their charge on our spear tips.

houses.name: Tiger's Unyielding Claw
houses.line: Hold the fords, guard the valley, strike when the mist clears.
